Description: AGENT-ENV (D-341): one Lambda per agent environment declared in config/agent-env/, outside the VPC, behind its own route on the port's HTTP API; it checks the sha256 of the bearer against its SSM String token-sha256 and answers the declared variables and its SSM SecureString secrets, refusing the whole bundle on a denied or undeclared name. The Torre relay tower-app-torre-relay, the one role that reads the Torre's webhook secrets, forwards an authenticated session's text on POST <endpoint>/v1/torre, one call per agent-env.torre_window_s per environment. Generated by scripts/lib/agent_env_stack.py; never edited by hand. Lambda and the route cost under US$ 0.05 a month.
